local wands = {
["destroyer"] = 34081,

["hellspawn"] = 34081,
["true frost flower asura"] = 35583,
["frost flower asura"] = 35583,
["true midnight asura"] = 34081,
["true dawnfire asura"] = 34081,
["cave hydra"] = 34081
}

macro(100, "Change Rod", function()
    if not g_game.isAttacking() then return end
    local Utarget = g_game.getAttackingCreature()
    for key, value in pairs(wands) do
        if Utarget and wands[Utarget:getName():lower()] then
            if not getLeft() or getLeft():getId() ~= tonumber(value) then
                moveToSlot(wands[Utarget:getName():lower()], SlotLeft)
            end
        end
    end
end)

--Revive pet
local useHerb = true
local petBodies = {4236,6038} -- 

RevivePet = macro(500,"Revive pet", function()
    for i, tile in ipairs(g_map.getTiles(posz())) do
        for u,item in ipairs(tile:getItems()) do
            if useHerb and table.find(petBodies, item:getId()) and findItem(34234) then
                useWith(34234, item)
            end
        end
    end
end)
